# Estimate the freight class before the quote.

> Estimate LTL freight class from pallet dimensions, weight, and piece count — then see the packed height that reaches the next class down, and the height at which a carrier remeasure re-rates the shipment.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
